Dholuo: Kata obedo ni piny Kenya osetimo dongruok maduong’ ahinya e duoko piny tuoche manyien mag HIV kod tho ma luwore gi tuo mar AIDS, nyaka wabed ka waketo pachwa kuom kwan mar ji ma waweyo bang’wa.

English: Progress is not success until every child, every adolescent, every young person and every vulnerable Kenyan has access to the services they need."
Kiswahili: Maendeleo si mafanikio hadi kila mtoto, kila kijana, kila kijana na kila Mkenya aliye hatarini apate huduma anazohitaji."
Dholuo: Dhi nyime ok en ber nyaka nyathi ka nyathi, ng’ato ka ng’ato ma jahigni apar gi aboro, ng’ato ka ng’ato ma rawera kod ng’ato ka ng’ato ma nigi pek e piny Kenya yudo kony ma gidwaro.”

English: "The resilience demonstrated by counties during the funding disruptions proved that Kenya's HIV response is not built on donor support alone, it is anchored in committed healthcare workers, empowered communities, and strong county leadership.
Kiswahili: "Ustahimilivu ulioonyeshwa na kaunti wakati wa kutatizwa kwa ufadhili ulithibitisha kuwa mwitikio wa VVU nchini Kenya hautegemei usaidizi wa wafadhili pekee, unaegemezwa na wafanyikazi wa afya waliojitolea, jamii zilizoimarishwa, na uongozi thabiti wa kaunti.
Dholuo: "Kinda ma ne onyis gi kaunti e kinde ma ne okethore gi pesa nonyiso ni dwoko mar HIV e piny Kenya ok ogere kuom kony mar jochiw kende, ochung'ne jotich mag thieth ma nigi gombo, oganda ma nigi teko, kod telo motegno mar kaunti."

English: "The launch of the 47 County Syndemic Operational Plans marks a defining moment in Kenya's health journey.
Kiswahili: "Kuzinduliwa kwa Mipango ya Uendeshaji ya Kaunti 47 inaashiria wakati mahususi katika safari ya afya ya Kenya.
Dholuo: "Chakruok mar chenro mag tich mag 47 mag kaunti nyiso kinde maduong' ahinya e safar mar thieth e piny Kenya.

English: These plans move us from commitment to action and place counties firmly at the centre of ending AIDS and other syndemic diseases as public health threats by 2030."
Kiswahili: Mipango hii inatusogeza kutoka kwa kujitolea kwa vitendo na kuweka kaunti katika kitovu cha kukomesha UKIMWI na magonjwa mengine kama matishio ya afya ya umma ifikapo 2030."
Dholuo: Pango gi miyo waweyo bedo gi gombo mar timo gimoro kendo keto kaunti matek e diere mar tieko tuo mar AIDS kod tuoche mamoko ma nyalo kelo luoro ne ngima mar oganda nyaka higa mar 2030."

English: Media plays a crucial role in shaping positive health outcomes, contributing significantly to Kenya’s success in combating HIV and AIDS.
Kiswahili: Vyombo vya habari vina jukumu muhimu katika kuunda matokeo chanya ya afya, na kuchangia kwa kiasi kikubwa mafanikio ya Kenya katika kupambana na VVU na UKIMWI.

English: This comprehensive approach aims to maximize outreach, fostering ongoing discussions on HIV prevention, and treatment, as well as addressing issues like sexual and gender-based violence, teen pregnancies, and COVID-19.
Kiswahili: Mbinu hii ya kina inalenga kuongeza uhamasishaji, kukuza mijadala inayoendelea kuhusu uzuiaji wa VVU na matibabu, pamoja na kushughulikia masuala kama vile unyanyasaji wa kingono na kijinsia, mimba za utotoni na COVID-19.

English: Response teams have been mobilized on the ground to reach the most affected communities.

Kiswahili: Zaidi ya arifa milioni 26 za tahadhari za mapema zimetumwa kwa jamii zilizo hatarini kote nchini.
Dholuo: SMS mokalo milion 26 mag riembo mapiyo oseoro ne gwenge ma ni e arita e piny mangima.

English: Currently, over 60,000 households have been affected across the country and more than 12,700 have been displaced.
Kiswahili: Hivi sasa, zaidi ya kaya 60,000 zimeathirika kote nchini na zaidi ya 12,700 wamelazimika kuyahama makazi yao.
Dholuo: Kuom sani, udi mokalo 60,000 oseyudo masira e pinyno duto kendo udi mokalo 12,700 osewuok e udigi.

English: The department provides immediate relief to affected populations to save lives, protect livelihoods, and strengthen recovery from disasters and crises

Kiswahili: Kielelezo cha 1: Idadi ya kesi zilizothibitishwa na zinazowezekana nchini Kenya zilizoripotiwa na wiki ya mwanzo ya ugonjwa kutoka 1 Januari hadi 25 Novemba 2017
Dholuo: Goro mar 1: Namba mar kes ma oyangore kod ma nyalo bedo ni nitie e piny Kenya ma ondiki kaluwore gi juma ma ne ochakoe tuo chakre tarik 1 dwe mar achiel nyaka tarik 25 dwe mar apar gi achiel higa mar 2017

English: From 1 January 2017 through 29 November, 20 of 47 counties (43%) in Kenya have reported cases.
Kiswahili: Kuanzia tarehe 1 Januari 2017 hadi 29 Novemba, kaunti 20 kati ya 47 (43%) nchini Kenya zimeripoti kesi.
Dholuo: Chakre tarik 1 dwe mar achiel higa mar 2017 nyaka tarik 29 dwe mar apar gi ariyo, kaunti 20 kuom kaunti 47 (43%) e piny Kenya oseyudo kes.

English: As of 29 November, seven counties continue to have active cholera outbreaks (Embu, Garissa, Kirinyaga, Mombasa, Nairobi, Turkana, and Wajir).
Kiswahili: Kufikia tarehe 29 Novemba, kaunti saba zinaendelea kuwa na milipuko ya ugonjwa wa kipindupindu (Embu, Garissa, Kirinyaga, Mombasa, Nairobi, Turkana, na Wajir).
Dholuo: Kaka 29 dwe mar apar gi ariyo, kaunti abiriyo pod dhi nyime gi bedo gi midhiero mag kolera (Embu, Garissa, Kirinyaga, Mombasa, Nairobi, Turkana, kod Wajir).

English: The epidemiology of cholera for Kenya in 2017 is characterized by continuous transmission in affected communities coupled with outbreaks in camp settings and institutions or during mass gathering events.
Kiswahili: Ugonjwa wa kipindupindu nchini Kenya mwaka wa 2017 una sifa ya maambukizi ya mara kwa mara katika jamii zilizoathirika pamoja na milipuko katika maeneo ya kambi na taasisi au wakati wa mikusanyiko ya watu wengi.
Dholuo: Okang’ ma ng’ato nyalo yudoe tuwo mar kolera e piny Kenya e higa mar 2017, ochung’ne ng’ado bura ma dhi nyime e alwora ma oyudo tuwono kaachiel gi ng’ado bura e kuonde ma ji ochung’ie kod kuonde ma ji odak e iye kata e kinde ma ji mang’eny romoe.

English: Continuous transmission in the community accounts for around 70% of the total cases with the majority of cases coming from the capital county, Nairobi.
Kiswahili: Uambukizaji unaoendelea katika jamii huchangia karibu 70% ya jumla ya visa huku visa vingi vikitoka katika kaunti kuu, Nairobi.
Dholuo: Odhi nyime gi lando tuwono e alwora kelo 70% mar kes duto ma thoth kesgo wuok e kaunti maduong’, Nairobi.

English: Transmission in camp settings occurred mainly within Garissa and Turkana counties, accounting for around 23% of the total reported cases.
Kiswahili: Usambazaji katika mipangilio ya kambi ulifanyika hasa katika kaunti za Garissa na Turkana, zikichukua takriban 23% ya jumla ya visa vilivyoripotiwa.
Dholuo: Oganda ma ne oyudo tuwono ne otimore ahinya e kind gwenge mag Garissa kod Turkana, ma ne oting’o 23% mar kwan mar jogo ma ne oyudo tuwono.

English: Both counties host big refugee camps, namely Dadaab and Kakuma refugee camps.
Kiswahili: Kaunti zote mbili zina kambi kubwa za wakimbizi, ambazo ni kambi za wakimbizi za Dadaab na Kakuma.
Dholuo: Kaunti ariyogo duto nigi kambi madongo mag jolweny, ma gin kambi mag jolweny mag Dadaab kod Kakuma.

English: Refugees in these camps come from countries currently experiencing complex emergencies and large cholera outbreaks.
Kiswahili: Wakimbizi katika kambi hizi wanatoka katika nchi ambazo kwa sasa zinakabiliwa na dharura tata na milipuko mikubwa ya kipindupindu.
Dholuo: Jolweny ma ni e kambi ma kamago wuok e pinje ma sani yudo masira mapek ahinya kendo ma nigi tuwo maduong’ mar kolera.

English: Seven percent of cases occurred in institutions and mass gathering events, where a number of people get infected from a point source.
Kiswahili: Asilimia saba ya visa vilitokea katika taasisi na hafla za mkusanyiko mkubwa, ambapo watu kadhaa huambukizwa kutoka kwa chanzo cha uhakika.
Dholuo: Abiriyo kuom mia achiel mag kesgo ne otimore e kuonde ma ji mang’eny romoe, kama kwan mar ji yudoe tuwono kowuok e kama giyudoree.

English: The country experiences cholera outbreaks every year; however, large cyclical epidemics occur approximately every five to seven years and last for two to three years.
Kiswahili: Nchi inakumbwa na milipuko ya kipindupindu kila mwaka; hata hivyo, magonjwa makubwa ya milipuko ya mzunguko hutokea takriban kila baada ya miaka mitano hadi saba na hudumu kwa miaka miwili hadi mitatu.
Dholuo: Pinyno yudo tuoche mag kolera higa ka higa; kata kamano, tuoche madongo ma ng’ato nyalo ng’ado e kindgi timore chiegni bang’ higni abich nyaka abiro kendo gibedo kuom higni ariyo nyaka adek.

English: The country has activated the national task force to coordinate the outbreak response activities.
Kiswahili: Nchi imeanzisha kikosi kazi cha kitaifa kuratibu shughuli za kukabiliana na milipuko.
Dholuo: Pinyno oseketo riwruok mar tich mar piny mangima mondo ochak tije mag geng'o tuo mar korona.

English: Since January 2017, WHO and other partners have been providing technical support to the country to control of the outbreak.
Kiswahili: Tangu Januari 2017, WHO na washirika wengine wamekuwa wakitoa msaada wa kiufundi kwa nchi kudhibiti mlipuko huo.
Dholuo: Chakre dwe mar achiel higa mar 2017, WHO kod jowete mamoko osebedo ka chiwo kony mar lony ne pinyno e thiro loyo mar korona.

English: Following the development of the national response plan, WHO and other partners supported the country to scale-up the outbreak response activities such as surveillance, case management, and social mobilization.
Kiswahili: Kufuatia kutayarishwa kwa mpango wa kitaifa wa mwitikio, WHO na washirika wengine walisaidia nchi kuongeza shughuli za kukabiliana na milipuko kama vile ufuatiliaji, udhibiti wa kesi, na uhamasishaji wa kijamii.
Dholuo: Bang’ loso chenro mar dwoko piny piny, WHO kod jowetene mamoko ne okonyo pinyno mondo omed ng’iyo tich mar dwoko piny tuo kaka ng’iyo, rito kes, kod loso oganda.

English: This was also coupled with the improvement of food hygiene standards and promotion of safe food handling, besides scaling-up Water, Sanitation, and Hygiene (WASH) related activities.
Kiswahili: Hii pia iliambatana na uboreshaji wa viwango vya usafi wa chakula na uhamasishaji wa utunzaji salama wa chakula, kando na kuongeza shughuli zinazohusiana na Maji, Usafi wa Mazingira na Usafi (WASH).
Dholuo: Mano bende ne oriwre gi bero rang’iny mar ler mar chiemo kod siro rito chiemo maber, ka ok oting’o medo kwan mar tije ma tudruok gi Pi, Rieko, kod Rieko (WASH).

English: This resulted in a decline in the number of cholera cases.
Kiswahili: Hii ilisababisha kupungua kwa idadi ya wagonjwa wa kipindupindu.
Dholuo: Mano ne omiyo kwan mar jogo ma ne oyudo tuwo mar kolera odok piny.

English: Despite the decline in the number of cases reported, the outbreak appears to be clustered around two major types of settings.
Kiswahili: Licha ya kupungua kwa idadi ya kesi zilizoripotiwa, kuzuka kunaonekana kuunganishwa karibu na aina mbili kuu za mipangilio.
Dholuo: Kata obedo ni kwan mar jogo ma oyudo tuwono osedok piny, nenore ni tuwono ochung’ e alwora ariyo madongo.

English: First, the refugee camps particularly Kakuma and Dadaab, and second in the populous Nairobi capital county.
Kiswahili: Kwanza, kambi za wakimbizi hasa Kakuma na Dadaab, na pili katika kaunti yenye watu wengi ya Nairobi.
Dholuo: Mokwongo, ne gin kambi mag jolweny ahinya ahinya e Kakuma kod Dadaab, to mar ariyo ne gin e gweng' maduong' mar Nairobi man kod oganda mathoth.

English: This could enable the spread of the outbreak to other districts.
Kiswahili: Hii inaweza kuwezesha kuenea kwa mlipuko katika wilaya zingine.
Dholuo: Mano nyalo miyo tuwono olandre e distrikt mamoko.

English: Also, previous outbreaks have shown that cases increase during the rainy season, which has started recently.
Kiswahili: Pia, milipuko ya awali imeonyesha kuwa kesi huongezeka wakati wa mvua, ambayo imeanza hivi karibuni.
Dholuo: Bende, tuoche ma osetimore chon osenyiso ni tuoche medore e kinde koth, ma osechako machiegni.

English: In addition, various physical, social, political, and environmental factors increase the vulnerability and the susceptibility of the country’s population to the cholera outbreaks.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya hayo, mambo mbalimbali ya kimwili, kijamii, kisiasa na kimazingira huongeza hatari na uwezekano wa idadi ya watu nchini kwa milipuko ya kipindupindu.
Dholuo: Bende, gik mopogore opogore ma timore e ringruok, e kind oganda, e siasa, kod e alwora medo bedo gi nyalo mar bedo gi tuwo mar kolera kendo bedo gi nyalo mar yudo tuwo mar kolera.

English: These include regional drought, conflict, and insecurity in the Horn of Africa, and the increased movement within and to the country by people fleeing conflicts in Somalia and South Sudan.
Kiswahili: Hizi ni pamoja na ukame wa kikanda, migogoro, na ukosefu wa usalama katika Pembe ya Afrika, na kuongezeka kwa harakati ndani na ndani ya nchi na watu wanaokimbia migogoro nchini Somalia na Sudan Kusini.
Dholuo: Magi oriwo oro, lweny, kod bedo ni onge arita e piny Tung' mar Afrika, kod medruok mar wuoth ei pinyno kendo donjo e pinyno kuom oganda maring'o lwenje e piny Somalia kod Sudan ma Milambo.

English: Overall, the risk of the current outbreak is assessed as high at the national level and low at the regional and global levels.
Kiswahili: Kwa ujumla, hatari ya mlipuko wa sasa inatathminiwa kuwa ya juu katika ngazi ya kitaifa na chini katika viwango vya kikanda na kimataifa.
Dholuo: Kuom duto, nyalo mar bedo gi tuwo ma sani nitie, opim ni en gima duong’ ahinya e rang’iny mar piny kendo ni piny e rang’iny mar ng’om kod piny mangima.

English: WHO recommends proper and timely case management in cholera treatment centres.
Kiswahili: WHO inapendekeza usimamizi sahihi na kwa wakati wa kesi katika vituo vya matibabu ya kipindupindu.
Dholuo: WHO ogolo paro ni mondo otimnegi thieth mowinjore kendo e kinde mowinjore e kuonde thieth mag kolera.

English: The affected communities should have improved access to water, effective sanitation, proper waste management, and enhanced hygiene and food safety practices.
Kiswahili: Jamii zilizoathiriwa zinapaswa kuboresha upatikanaji wa maji, vyoo bora, udhibiti sahihi wa taka, na kuimarisha kanuni za usafi na usalama wa chakula.
Dholuo: Jodak ma ne oyudo masirano ne onego obed gi yore maber mag yudo pi, rito ler maber, rito yugi maber, kod yore mabeyo mag rito ler kod chiemo.

English: Key public health communication messages should be provided.
Kiswahili: Ujumbe muhimu wa mawasiliano ya afya ya umma unapaswa kutolewa.
Dholuo: Owinjore omi weche madongo mag tudruok e wi thieth mar oganda.

English: WHO encourages travellers to the affected area to take proper hygiene precautions to prevent potential exposure.
Kiswahili: WHO inawahimiza wasafiri kwenda eneo lililoathiriwa kuchukua tahadhari sahihi za usafi ili kuzuia kuambukizwa.
Dholuo: WHO jiwo jolendo ma dhi e kuonde ma tuono oyudoree mondo okaw okang’ mowinjore mar rito ler mondo kik giyud tuono.

English: WHO does not recommend any restriction on travel and trade to Kenya based on the information available on the current outbreak.
Kiswahili: WHO haipendekezi vikwazo vyovyote vya usafiri na biashara hadi Kenya kulingana na taarifa zilizopo kuhusu mlipuko wa sasa.
Dholuo: WHO ok ogolo chik moro amora kuom wuotho ​​kod ohala e piny Kenya kaluwore gi weche ma nitie e wi tuo mar korona.

English: Disease outbreak - Cholera - Kenya - 21 July 2017 | WHO | Regional Office for Africa
Kiswahili: Mlipuko wa magonjwa - Kipindupindu - Kenya - 21 Julai 2017 | NANI | Ofisi ya Kanda ya Afrika
Dholuo: Tuwo ma ng’ato nyalo ng’ado - Kolera - Kenya - 21 dwe mar Julaini higa mar 2017 | NG’ANO | Ofis mar Kinda mar Afrika

English: Since the beginning of 2017, Kenya is experiencing an upsurge of cholera cases.
Kiswahili: Tangu mwanzoni mwa 2017, Kenya inakabiliwa na ongezeko la wagonjwa wa kipindupindu.
Dholuo: Chakre chakruok mar higa mar 2017, piny Kenya yudo omedruok mar tuo mar kolera.

English: The first cholera outbreak reported in 2017 was in Tana River County.
Kiswahili: Mlipuko wa kwanza wa kipindupindu kuripotiwa mwaka wa 2017 ulikuwa katika Kaunti ya Tana River.
Dholuo: Tuwo mar kolera mokwongo mane oyudre e higa mar 2017 ne en e Kaunti mar Tana River.

English: The outbreak started on 10 October 2016 and was controlled by April 2017.
Kiswahili: Mlipuko huo ulianza tarehe 10 Oktoba 2016 na ulidhibitiwa ifikapo Aprili 2017.
Dholuo: Two no ne ochakore tarik 10 dwe mar Apar higa mar 2016 kendo ne olohi kokalo dwe mar Ang'wen higa mar 2017.

English: A second wave of cholera outbreaks started in Garissa County on 2 April 2017 and was reported later in nine other counties including Nairobi, Murang’a, Vihiga, Mombasa, Turkana, Kericho, Nakuru, Kiambu, and Narok.
Kiswahili: Wimbi la pili la mkurupuko wa kipindupindu lilianza katika Kaunti ya Garissa mnamo 2 Aprili 2017 na kuripotiwa baadaye katika kaunti zingine tisa zikiwemo Nairobi, Murang’a, Vihiga, Mombasa, Turkana, Kericho, Nakuru, Kiambu, na Narok.
Dholuo: Awa mar ariyo mar midhiero mar kolera ne ochakre e gweng' mar Garissa tarik 2 dwe mar ang'wen higa mar 2017 kendo bang'e ne owinre e gweng' mamoko 9 moriwo Nairobi, Murang'a, Vihiga, Mombasa, Turkana, Kericho, Nakuru, Kiambu, kod Narok.

English: The outbreak is being reported in the general population and in refugee camps.
Kiswahili: Mlipuko huo unaripotiwa katika idadi ya watu na katika kambi za wakimbizi.
Dholuo: Oganda mathoth kendo e kambi mag jolweny osebedo ka ng’iyo pinyno.

English: In Garissa County, the outbreak is affecting mainly Dadaab refugee camps and cases and deaths are being reported from Hagadera, Dagahaleh, and IFO2 camps.
Kiswahili: Katika Kaunti ya Garissa, mlipuko huo unaathiri zaidi kambi za wakimbizi za Dadaab na visa na vifo vinaripotiwa kutoka kambi za Hagadera, Dagahaleh, na IFO2.
Dholuo: E Kambi mar Garissa, tuo no omako ahinya kambi mag jolwen ma Dadaab kendo kes kod tho iyudore kowuok e kambi mag Hagadera, Dagahaleh, kod IFO2.

English: In Turkana county, the disease is also affecting Kakuma and Kalobeyei refugee camps.
Kiswahili: Katika kaunti ya Turkana, ugonjwa huo pia unaathiri kambi za wakimbizi za Kakuma na Kalobeyei.
Dholuo: E aluora mar Turkana, tuo ni bende omako kambi jolwen mag Kakuma kod Kalobeyei.

English: In addition to the outbreak reported in the general population, there have been two point source cholera outbreaks in Nairobi County.
Kiswahili: Mbali na mkurupuko huo ulioripotiwa katika idadi ya watu, kumekuwa na milipuko miwili ya chanzo cha kipindupindu katika Kaunti ya Nairobi.
Dholuo: Kaachiel gi tuo mar kolera ma oseyudore e kind oganda duto, nitie tuoche ariyo ma osebedo ka kelo tuoche mag kolera e gweng’ mar Nairobi.

English: One occurred among participants attending a conference in a Nairobi hotel on 22 June 2017.
Kiswahili: Moja ilitokea miongoni mwa washiriki waliohudhuria kongamano katika hoteli moja Nairobi tarehe 22 Juni 2017.
Dholuo: Achiel ne otimore e kind jogo mane ochopo e chokruok e otel moro ma Nairobi tarik 22 dwe mar auchiel higa mar 2017.

English: A total of 146 patients associated with this outbreak have been treated in different hospitals in Nairobi.
Kiswahili: Jumla ya wagonjwa 146 wanaohusishwa na mkurupuko huu wametibiwa katika hospitali tofauti jijini Nairobi.
Dholuo: Jotuwo 146 ma tudruok gi tuwoni osethiedh e osiptal mopogore opogore mag Nairobi.

English: A second outbreak occurred at the China Trade Fair held at the KICC Tsavo Ball between 10 and 12 July 2017.
Kiswahili: Mlipuko wa pili ulitokea katika Maonyesho ya Biashara ya Uchina yaliyofanyika kwenye Mpira wa KICC Tsavo kati ya tarehe 10 na 12 Julai 2017.
Dholuo: Okang' mar ariyo ne otimore e nyiso mar ohala mar China mane olose e KICC Tsavo Ball e kind tarik 10 gi 12 dwe mar abiriyo higa mar 2017.

English: A total of 136 cases were reported and one death.
Kiswahili: Jumla ya kesi 136 ziliripotiwa na kifo kimoja.
Dholuo: Ne oyudo kes 136 kendo achiel notho.

English: Currently, the outbreak is active in two counties, namely Garissa and Nairobi.
Kiswahili: Kwa sasa, mkurupuko huo unaendelea katika kaunti mbili, ambazo ni Garissa na Nairobi.
Dholuo: Kuom sani, loch ni olandore e kaunti ariyo, ma gin Garissa kod Nairobi.

English: As of 17 July 2017, a total of 1216 suspected cases including 14 deaths (case fatality rate: 1.2%) have been reported since 1 January 2017.
Kiswahili: Kufikia tarehe 17 Julai 2017, jumla ya kesi 1216 zinazoshukiwa ikiwa ni pamoja na vifo 14 (kiwango cha vifo vya kesi: 1.2%) zimeripotiwa tangu 1 Januari 2017.
Dholuo: Kaka 17 dwe mar auchiel higa mar 2017, kwan mar kes 1216 ma igeno ni nigi tuo mar tho ma oting’o tho 14 (kwan mar tho mag kes: 1.2%) osetimre chakre tarik 1 dwe mar achiel higa mar 2017.

English: In the week ending 16 July 2017, a total of 38 cases with no deaths were reported.
Kiswahili: Katika wiki inayoishia tarehe 16 Julai 2017, jumla ya visa 38 bila vifo viliripotiwa.
Dholuo: E juma ma ne orum tarik 16 dwe mar auchiel higa mar 2017, ne oyudre ni ji 38 ma onge ng’at ma notho.

English: A total of 124 cases tested positive for Vibrio cholerae in the reference laboratory.
Kiswahili: Jumla ya visa 124 vilipatikana na Vibrio cholerae katika maabara ya kumbukumbu.
Dholuo: 124 ma ne oyudre gi tuo mar kolera e kar ranyisi ma ne itiyogo.

English: In the week ending 25 June 2017, 18 samples out of 25 tested positive for Vibrio cholerae Ogawa by culture at the National Public Health Laboratory in Nairobi.
Kiswahili: Wiki inayoishia tarehe 25 Juni 2017, sampuli 18 kati ya 25 zilithibitishwa kuwa na Vibrio cholerae Ogawa kulingana na utamaduni katika Maabara ya Kitaifa ya Afya ya Umma jijini Nairobi.
Dholuo: E juma mane orumo tarik 25 dwe mar auchiel higa mar 2017, sampol 18 kuom sampol 25 ne oyudi gi midhusi mar kolera kaluwore gi kit oganda e Kar Rang'iny mar Thieth mar Oganda ma Nairobi.

English: The main causative factors of the current outbreak include the high population density that is conducive to the propagation and spread of the disease, mass gatherings (a wedding party held in Karen and in a hotel during an international conference), low access to safe water and proper sanitation and the massive population movements in country and with neighbouring countries.
Kiswahili: Sababu kuu za mlipuko wa sasa ni pamoja na msongamano mkubwa wa watu ambao unafaa kwa uenezi na kuenea kwa ugonjwa huo, mikusanyiko ya watu wengi (karamu ya harusi iliyofanyika Karen na katika hoteli wakati wa mkutano wa kimataifa), upatikanaji mdogo wa maji salama na usafi wa mazingira unaofaa na harakati kubwa ya watu nchini na nchi jirani.
Dholuo: Gik madongo ma kelo tuo mar korona gin kaka kwan maduong’ mar oganda ma nyalo konyo e lando kendo lando tuo mar korona, chokruok mathoth (nyasi mar keny ma ne otim e Karen kendo e otel e kinde chokruok mar piny mangima), yudo pi maler kod ler mowinjore kod kwan maduong’ mar oganda ma ni e pinje ma machiegni.

English: Since December 2014, the Republic of Kenya has been experiencing continuous large outbreaks of cholera, with a cumulative total of 17 597 cases reported (10 568 cases reported in 2015 and 6448 in 2016).
Kiswahili: Tangu Desemba 2014, Jamhuri ya Kenya imekuwa ikikumbwa na milipuko mikubwa ya kipindupindu, na jumla ya kesi 17 597 zimeripotiwa (kesi 10 568 ziliripotiwa mwaka wa 2015 na 6448 mwaka wa 2016).
Dholuo: Chakre dwe mar apar gi ariyo higa mar 2014, piny Kenya osebedo ka yudo tuoche madongo mag kolera ma dhi nyime, kendo kwan mar jogo ma oyudo tuwo mar kolera romo 17 597 (tuwo 10 568 ma ne oyudo e higa mar 2015 to 6448 e higa mar 2016).

English: The country has activated the national task force to coordinate the response to the outbreak.
Kiswahili: Nchi imeanzisha kikosi kazi cha kitaifa kuratibu mwitikio wa mlipuko huo.
Dholuo: Pinyno osetiyo gi riwruok mar piny mangima mondo ochung' ne dwoko mar tuwo mar korona.

English: Since January 2017, WHO and partners are providing technical support to the country for the control of the outbreak.
Kiswahili: Tangu Januari 2017, WHO na washirika wanatoa msaada wa kiufundi kwa nchi kwa udhibiti wa mlipuko huo.
Dholuo: Chakre dwe mar achiel higa mar 2017, WHO kod jowetene chiwo kony mar lony ne pinyno e thiro midhiero mar korona.

English: The country will develop a response plan with focus on the preparedness interventions to avert further spread of the outbreak.
Kiswahili: Nchi itaandaa mpango wa majibu kwa kuzingatia hatua za kujitayarisha ili kuzuia kuenea zaidi kwa mlipuko huo.
Dholuo: Piny biro loso chenro mar dwoko ma keto pach kuom yore mag ikruok mondo ogeng’ lalruok mar tuo mar korona.

English: The WHO country office will repurpose their staff members and experts deployed in Nairobi for the management of the post El Niño effects in the Horn of Africa to support the quick control of this outbreak.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya nchi ya WHO itawatumia tena wafanyikazi wake na wataalam waliotumwa Nairobi kwa usimamizi wa athari za El Niño katika Pembe ya Afrika ili kusaidia udhibiti wa haraka wa mlipuko huu.
Dholuo: Ofis mar piny WHO biro loso kendo jotichgi kod jolony ma gioro e Nairobi mondo ochung’ ne rito gik ma nyalo timore bang’ El Niño e piny Afrika mondo okony e geng’o mapiyo tuo mar korona.

English: WHO will also support the five most at risk counties with disease surveillance and response coordination.
Kiswahili: WHO pia itaunga mkono kaunti tano zilizo hatarini zaidi na ufuatiliaji wa magonjwa na uratibu wa kukabiliana.
Dholuo: WHO bende biro konyo county abich ma ni e arita maduong’ie moloyo kuom ng’iyo tuoche kod loso chenro mar dwokogi.

English: Partners on the ground are committed to provide support to the ongoing response efforts including support to primary health care and social mobilization by United Nations Children’s Fund (UNICEF).
Kiswahili: Washirika mashinani wamejitolea kutoa msaada kwa juhudi zinazoendelea za kukabiliana na hali hiyo ikiwa ni pamoja na usaidizi wa huduma za afya ya msingi na uhamasishaji wa kijamii na Shirika la Umoja wa Mataifa la Kuhudumia Watoto (UNICEF).
Dholuo: Joma tiyo kanyakla e pinyno ochung’ motegno mar chiwo kony ne tich ma dhi nyime mar dwoko ma oting’o kony ne thieth mokwongo kod loso gik moko e kind oganda gi riwruok mar nyithindo mag piny mangima (UNICEF).

English: Cholera is an acute enteric infection caused by the ingestion of bacterium Vibrio cholerae present in faecally contaminated water or food.
Kiswahili: Kipindupindu ni maambukizi makali ya tumbo yanayosababishwa na kumeza bakteria aina ya Vibrio cholerae iliyopo kwenye maji au chakula kilichochafuliwa na kinyesi.
Dholuo: Kolera en tuwo mager mar ich ma ikelo gi ng’ato ka ng’ato ma ng’ato ochamo gik ma kelo kwiri ma iye ( Vibrio kolerae ) ma yudore e pi kata chiemo ma nigi lak.

English: It is primarily linked to insufficient access to safe water and adequate sanitation.
Kiswahili: Kimsingi inahusishwa na upatikanaji duni wa maji salama na usafi wa mazingira wa kutosha.
Dholuo: Otudore ahinya gi bedo maonge gi pi maler moromo kod bedo gi ler moromo.

English: Cholera is always considered a potentially serious infectious disease and can cause high morbidity and mortality.
Kiswahili: Kipindupindu daima huchukuliwa kuwa ugonjwa hatari wa kuambukiza na unaweza kusababisha magonjwa mengi na vifo.
Dholuo: Kinde duto, kolera okawe kaka tuo ma nyalo mako ng’ato kendo nyalo kelo tuoche mang’eny kod tho mang’eny.

English: It has the potential to spread rapidly, depending on the exposure frequency, population exposed and the context.
